About.metaDescription: Hosseini Naveh history and the Green Diamond Farm export brand — from farming to pistachio export.
About.title: About the company
About.lead: A family path from farming to pistachio export.
About.heading: Hosseini Naveh
About.p1: Hosseini Naveh began under Mr. Asghar Hosseini Naveh in 1987 with agricultural work. In 1992 the family entered domestic pistachio trade, and from 1996 started international pistachio export.
About.p2: Green Diamond Farm ({brand}) continues that work today — clear grades and direct buyer contact.
About.imageAlt: Pistachio kernels prepared for export packing
About.historyNote: Farming since 1987, domestic trade since 1992, export since 1996.
About.standBody: Supply graded pistachios, answer inquiries clearly, and prepare export documents and packing.
About.certsBody: Export documents and certificates are provided when buyers need them.
About.marketsBody: Iraq, China, Russia, Turkmenistan, Saudi Arabia, Germany, and other target markets.

Privacy.metaDescription: How Green Diamond Farm handles contact information on this marketing site — no accounts, no analytics cookies.
Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.lead: {brand} is a static marketing site. This page describes what we do — and do not — collect.
Privacy.collectBody: This website does not run account sign-in, contact forms, or first-party analytics. If you email, call, or message us, that conversation happens through your mail, phone, or WhatsApp apps — not through a form on this site.
Privacy.cookiesBody: We do not set marketing or analytics cookies. The host may use strictly necessary technical cookies to serve the site securely.
Privacy.contactBody: Email, phone, and WhatsApp links on the Contact page are published so buyers can reach the export desk directly.
Privacy.thirdBody: Opening WhatsApp, mailto, or tel links leaves this site and follows the privacy terms of those apps or providers. Some atmosphere photographs currently load from a stock image CDN until owned product photography is published.
Privacy.reachBody: For privacy questions about this site, contact the export desk.
